raw.query: WITH hf AS (SELECT n_images, mean_ms AS hf_ms FROM provenance.collector_encoder_fn WHERE source_path LIKE '%fn_repro.json' AND engine='eager' AND is_valid AND n_images <= 64), vl AS (SELECT n_images, mean_ms AS vllm_ms FROM provenance.collector_encoder_fn WHERE source_path LIKE '%vllm_eager_dense.json' AND engine='vllm' AND is_valid AND n_images <= 64), r AS (SELECT hf.n_images AS n, hf.hf_ms / vl.vllm_ms AS ratio FROM hf JOIN vl USING (n_images)) SELECT count(*) AS n_points, min(ratio) AS ratio_min, max(ratio) AS ratio_max, avg(ratio) AS ratio_mean, count(*) FILTER (WHERE ratio < 1.4) AS n_below_1_4, count(*) FILTER (WHERE ratio > 1.6) AS n_above_1_6 FROM r;
raw.claimed: HuggingFace forward is 1.4–1.6× slower over N≤64
raw.evidence: collector_encoder_fn fn_repro(eager)/vllm_eager_dense matched-N mean_ms ratios span 1.366–1.591; claimed range 1.4–1.6 matches only at 1-decimal rounding and strictly excludes 3 low-N points below 1.4
raw.fix: Soften or correct the endpoints: '≈1.4–1.6×' or state the measured range '1.37–1.59×' (e.g. 'HuggingFace forward is $1.37$--$1.59\times$ slower over the same range')
